header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present on behalf of the petitioners nor any intimation is received.
This petition was filed in the year 2021 and lastly fixed on 07.05.2025.
Thereafter, no efforts have been made by the counsel for petitioners to fix the
body: matter in Court and to proceed with the matter. It appears that counsel for petitioners has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
